senses.gloss: f.demon Ts’rada, name of a disease, (supposed to be) vertigo.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 105b:6">Ḥull. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>דקשי לר׳ צ׳</he> (Ar. <he>צדדה</he>; Ms. R. 3 <cite ref="R00086"><he>צדדא</he></cite>, Rashi M. <cite ref="R00812"><he>צררא</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) it is bad for (it begets) vertigo.
Pes. 111ᵇ אחדא ליה ר׳ צ׳ vertigo seized him (Rashi: megrim, prob. reading צְדָדָא).
